state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 9 (the AD extras) is under way**: sort with a VLV window and deleted objects are on `main`. `sort_and_a_vlv_window_return_the_requested_slice` and `show_deleted_finds_a_deleted_entry` pass against `samba-ad`. Stages 1 to 5, 7 and 8 are done. Stage 4 is done except for a CA that a program supplies. Stage 6 is done except wiring the schema into the readers. Stage 9's DirSync and the Global Catalog are not written.

**On `main`**: everything Stage 8 listed, plus sort and window (`crates/nvs-ldap/src/conn.rs` module doc, "A window is one answer"; `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs` module doc for why the window is two flat options), and now `SearchRequest::show_deleted` with `Control::show_deleted` (`.417`, no value, critical) pushed in `Cursor::new`. `search` takes `showDeleted: bool` (its twelfth argument), and adds `isDeleted` to a non-empty `select` so `Ldap\Entry::isDeleted(): bool` always reads it. `tests/conformance/core/ldap-show-deleted-finds-a-deleted-entry.nvst` pins it from Novis; its deleted entries accumulate across runs, so it counts them as "at least one".

Server cases reach `samba-ad` (`tests/db/compose.yaml`) at `ldaps://localhost:16636`, and plain LDAP at 16389. Write cases add and delete their own entries under names no other case uses: OUs `Shop`/`Blog`/`Store`/`Framework`/`Example`/`Catalog`/`Library`/`Gallery`/`Studio`/`Archive`/`Theater`/`Cinema` (cases) and `Museum` (Rust) at the root, and each test user `CN=<name>,OU=<name>` in an OU of its own (`Team`, `Editors`, `Visitors`, `Members`, `Readers` in Rust; `Staff`, `Authors`, `Owners`, `Clients` in cases). Grep the name across `tests/conformance/core/ldap-*.nvst` and `crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/ldap.rs` before taking one. A deleted entry cannot be removed, so a test that deletes must not assume it is the only tombstone.
